commentary_segments.text: All three design plans lead to the same optimum indeed. There is a slight preference for choosing the compensation capacitance C c first as this capacitance can only have a small range of values. Indeed, it cannot be smaller than about 3×C . n1 On the other hand, it cannot be larger than the load capacitance C divided L by 2–3. It is now fairly easy to choose this compensation capacitance about right. This is why so many designers simply choose C as a starting point for their design procedure. c Of course, even better is to try a few different capacitance values! Let us work out an example first!

There is a slight preference for choosing the compensation capacitance C c first as this capacitance can only have a small range of values. Indeed, it cannot be smaller than about 3×C . n1 On the other hand, it cannot be larger than the load capacitance C divided L by 2–3. It is now fairly easy to choose this compensation capacitance about right.
